title: Smarter companions
text:
Your hired companions now fight like a real party.

✨ Every companion has a signature ability: Barbarian Execute on weakened foes, Assassin Eviscerate, Hunter Volley against groups, Arcanist Chain Lightning, Bard Song of Valor (+15% party damage and a small heal)
✨ The tank raises Shield Wall when badly hurt (half damage for 6 seconds); the Mender casts Circle of Light when several allies are wounded
• Companions step out of boss ground attacks instead of standing in them
• Companions now taunt from range when a monster runs for you, and no longer get stuck behind walls in melee
